posts.title: Educating a girl is not charity. It is the foundation everything else stands on.
posts.body:
Poverty, distance, early marriage. In the villages of the Avé Prefecture, a girl's education is negotiated year by year against everything else a family has to pay for.

Our Executive Director makes the case that schooling a girl is an investment rather than a gift — and shows how education, healthcare, water and sanitation, and women's empowerment only hold each other up when they run together.

[Read the full article →](/news/educating-a-girl/)

posts.title: Welcome to the new APED website
posts.body:
We are proud to launch APED's new home online.

Here you can follow our work across the Avé Prefecture of Togo — education, rural healthcare, water and sanitation, and women's empowerment — and see the progress of the **Kpotamé Rural Health Center for Women & Children**.

This News section is where we will share stories from the field, project milestones, and ways you can stand with the communities we serve.

Thank you for being part of this journey.
